summary: Sapiens learning feed backend (iteration 3) tested end-to-end. 16 pytest cases covering /api/feed pagination + schema flexibility, /api/feed/interactions auth + accumulation + auto-progress, /api/feed/progress defaults + persistence, admin CRUD (create + auto-sequence + patch + published-toggle hides from feed + delete + idempotent 404), and regression on /api/auth/login, /api/exams, /api/analyses trash filter. 16/16 passed on first run.
critical_code_review_comments: feed_routes.py: All /admin/feed-items endpoints only require_user with NO admin/role check — any authenticated user can create/update/delete feed cards. Add an admin role gate (same issue previously flagged for /api/admin/paste-answer-key).

feed_routes.py log_interaction: interaction_id is assigned `_now()` (ISO timestamp string) instead of a UUID. Two rapid inserts for different (user, content) pairs could theoretically collide on ms boundary; use uuid4 like the pydantic default in FeedInteraction.
feed_routes.py get_feed: has_more logic runs an extra count_documents on every page — for larger feeds prefer `find(limit+1)` and pop the sentinel to avoid the second query.

feed_seed.seed_feed uses a `feed_seed_version` marker (idempotent) but does `feed_items.delete_many({})` before seed on first run — if admins ever pre-populate items before startup they would be wiped. Safe today because it's guarded by the marker, but fragile.
feed_routes admin_create_item: sequence_order=0 sentinel means clients cannot explicitly set 0. Consider using None to mean auto-assign to avoid overloading a valid integer value.

feed_models FeedItem: `updated_at` is present in the model but never returned by the seed insert (seed items only get default at insert time which is fine); no issue but note the PATCH endpoint sets updated_at only — created_at is untouched, correct.
test_credentials: qa@sapiens.app / qa12345 (login worked). Dynamic fresh_<hex>@sapiens.app user created per module for default-progress test.
seed_data_creation: Test created and then deleted 1 admin feed item (sequence auto-assigned to max+1, then patched to +100). Fresh user has last_position=4 + one completed_content_id persisted (not cleaned up — small, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feed module works as spec'd: cursor/limit pagination correct, has_more accurate, limit>30 -> 422, unpublished items excluded from /api/feed but visible in /api/admin/feed-items, interactions upsert on (user,content_id) accumulating time_spent_ms and appending events, completed=true adds to progress.completed_content_ids via $addToSet (deduped). Regression on /exams, /auth/login, /analyses trash filter still green. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_feed.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (pytest.ini enforces -n 2 loadscope). Prior v2 suite at /app/backend/tests/test_sapiens_v2.py not re-run this iteration (feed is purely additive, existing endpoints regression-covered here).
